criteriaReviewed.observation: One raw preview_packing owner and one wrapper are linked by the runtime adapter. The existing policy priority places PreviewPacking after subset and before selected_rigid. No new SRC program is introduced.

Source record requires a selected proposal carrying preview_packing_plan. Native acquisition invokes raw record only for selected PreviewPacking actions; the passive path does not invoke raw PreviewPacking record.

The caller stores and actually restores the exact four-field source state after actions when a model is retained, including actions selected by another family. The checkpoint remains after Workshop and before Axial.

sourceState exposes packing_events, packing_model, packing_controls and _packing_scene_cache. nativeState uses the flat native.preview_packing.v1 envelope. Validation, detached copies, immutable memoized snapshots and equivalent-state restore fast paths were read.
A blocking PreviewPacking refusal propagates through currentProposalRefusal to a blocking unknown frontier offer and stops selection before an action. Refusal state is reset for each proposal.

Plan commands, steps, offered actions, policy identity and source policy hash are checked. The first step binds raster digest, observation reference, epoch/score and current availability; later steps use the observed preview pose guard.
Point selection binds exactly one currently observed entity and its signature, bounds, frame, epoch, palette and point. It is not an unbound coordinate action.

An epoch or score boundary seals the step without a matched result. Source record treats an epoch boundary as an empty return envelope without resetting retained model or controls; score-only change is not silently treated as an epoch reset.
The model, controls and events are acquired from selected actual returns. Only a unit translation or a unique matching transform is learned; propose itself only changes the scene cache.
Null scene results may be retained for the entire epoch. A new epoch permits scene measurement while learned controls remain retained. State changes invalidate the retained snapshot.
Consumed partition and shape-orbit behavior, lexicographic piece order, fixed interior poses, equal-cost tie behavior and Manhattan-plus-mask-difference cost were compared with the pinned source.
The local dictionary-to-point-set helper accounts for CPython set(dict) presizing rather than assuming sequential set insertion gives the same traversal. The shared point-set helper is unchanged.

The consumed piece, mask and world/pose limits and residual domain/depth/node/time bounds were reviewed, together with the bounded control search, current deadline, abort checks and bounded command prefix.
Bound, deadline and cancellation interruptions become explicit blocking unknown outcomes. They do not authorize a partial plan or claim that the remaining problem is impossible.
Both NativePreviewPacking and PreviewPackingWork now store Object.freeze(previewPackingLimits(...)) as Readonly<PreviewPackingLimits>; the final constructor deltas were reread.

Both learned translation and transform controls are installed with Object.defineProperty as enumerable own data properties. The existing copy helper uses Object.fromEntries for certified JSON objects and structuredClone otherwise, preserving a literal __proto__ control key as data.

conclusion.statement: No concrete contractual defect found in the bounded static review. This is a source-review receipt, not an execution or equivalence certificate.

limitations: The source 2000 ms residual budget is not a 2000 ms bound on the complete proposal call.
Geometry measurement is finite and synchronous; this review does not establish a hard latency bound or immediate pause responsiveness.
Blocking at bounded control-search exhaustion before unknown-control fallback is an explicit native safety adaptation; the source can reach fallback after its search cap.
Later-step revalidation is pose-based rather than a fresh full-raster equality proof.
An epoch-local null scene cache can suppress later measurement in that same epoch.
Learned controls are not universally retracted after divergence, and selection without recoloring may repeat, consistent with the reviewed source limitations.
Source history and scene cache are not compacted; this review does not prove performance over hours of use.
A geometric partition is not proof of physical transport or of an official terminal success condition.
The component and integration review is bounded and does not establish whole-caller parity, all possible environment behavior or whole-game completion.
The lost historical 0.60 candidate and its observations remain historical; this reconstructed candidate requires its own freeze and qualification.
These fingerprints identify the inputs at receipt creation. Any subsequent change to an audited input requires explicit revalidation before treating this receipt as applicable.
